The corridor has fallen utterly silent.

Did a gale tear through it? Parts of the hall have been scoured away as though by an enormous file, leaving it half destroyed.

Amid the ruin, on the only patch of floor left intact, the faintest stain of red remains.

pages.en:
Only after Rider is out of sight do I set off alone.

Why she saved me is a question for later.

…It is an hour's walk home.

And in that single hour, I have to shake off every lingering image of her now that she is gone.
